# ASADS Home Inspection

> Home inspection and environmental testing company serving Toronto, the GTA and more than 100 communities across southern Ontario. Phone (647) 801-9311. Website https://www.asads.ca

ASADS inspects homes for buyers, sellers and owners, and tests for asbestos, mold, air quality, radon and well water. It also does WETT (wood-burning appliance) inspections, pre-delivery (PDI) inspections on new builds, and commercial building inspections. ASADS is an independent inspector; it does not do mold remediation.

## Services

- [Pre-purchase home inspection](https://www.asads.ca/services/pre-purchase): for buyers in Ontario
- [Pre-listing inspection](https://www.asads.ca/services/pre-listing): for sellers before listing
- [Asbestos testing](https://www.asads.ca/services/asbestos-testing): sampling with accredited laboratory analysis
- [Designated substance survey](https://www.asads.ca/services/designated-substance-survey): before renovation or demolition
- [Mold inspection and testing](https://www.asads.ca/services/mold-inspection)
- [Indoor air quality testing](https://www.asads.ca/services/air-quality)
- [Radon testing](https://www.asads.ca/services/radon-testing)
- [Well water testing](https://www.asads.ca/services/well-water-testing)
- [WETT inspection](https://www.asads.ca/services/wett): wood stoves, fireplaces and inserts, often required by insurers
- [Pre-delivery inspection (PDI)](https://www.asads.ca/services/pdi-inspection): new-build homes
- [Commercial building inspection](https://www.asads.ca/services/commercial)
- [Condo inspection](https://www.asads.ca/services/condo)
- [Thermal imaging](https://www.asads.ca/services/thermal-imaging)
- [Insurance home inspection](https://www.asads.ca/services/insurance-inspection)
- [Service areas](https://www.asads.ca/locations)
